categories.main_business_segments: The company focuses on cell and gene therapy CRO (Contract Research Organization) and CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization) services. It provides gene therapy vector development, gene function research, drug target and efficacy research, process development, IND-CMC pharmaceutical research, clinical sample and commercial GMP production. Additionally, it offers regenerative medicine services including cell preparation, recombinant protein/exosome production, and cell storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technology clusters in cell and gene therapy vector development and production process and quality control. It utilizes molecular biology platforms, virus vector packaging platforms, cell function research, SPF animal experiment platforms, GMP production lines, and advanced quality control systems. Technologies include AAV, lentivirus, adenovirus, mRNA-LNP delivery, CAR-T/NK cell therapies, stem cell 3D culture, and AI-assisted vector design.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include research institutions, pharmaceutical companies, and medical institutions engaged in cell and gene therapy drug development and regenerative medicine. The company serves over 12,800 research laboratories and numerous innovative drug developers domestically and internationally, supporting clinical and commercial production stages.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Shanghai, including the Lingang Precision Medical Industrial Base. It also has subsidiaries in the United States and serves global markets, expanding overseas CRO and CDMO services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream service provider in the cell and gene therapy supply chain, offering outsourced R&D, process development, clinical sample production, and commercial manufacturing services to drug developers and research institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core vector development technologies, expanding production scale and efficiency, integrating AI for vector design, and developing new modalities such as mRNA-LNP and exosome platforms. The company focuses on large-scale GMP production, quality control innovation, and expanding into regenerative medicine and anti-aging applications. It also emphasizes intellectual property protection and international market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized CRO and CDMO services, including gene therapy vector packaging, cell therapy process development, clinical and commercial GMP production, and regenerative medicine services. The company also sells biological reagents and products. Revenue recognition is based on milestone completion and delivery confirmation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic cell and gene therapy CRO/CDMO provider, with comprehensive technology platforms and large-scale GMP production capacity. It competes with both specialized CGT CDMO firms and large pharmaceutical CRO/CDMO companies expanding into cell and gene therapy. The industry is highly competitive with rapid technological evolution and market consolidation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 248 million, a 21.16% increase year-over-year. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 322 million, reflecting increased operating costs from new production base ramp-up and industry pricing pressures. Total assets were RMB 2.28 billion with equity of RMB 1.74 billion. The company continues investing heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a one-stop, full-cycle service platform from early research to commercial production for cell and gene therapy products, leveraging advanced proprietary vector technologies, diverse product capabilities (including AAV, lentivirus, CAR-T, stem cells, mRNA), and large-scale GMP manufacturing. Its integration of AI and comprehensive quality control systems enhances efficiency and product consistency, providing clients with reliable, scalable, and innovative solutions to accelerate drug development and commercialization.
